newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel guns for 131.56 if 130.88 holds.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel guns for 131.56 if 130.88 holds.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF have their sights set on resistance from a continuation chart high at 131.56, technical analysts said on Wednesday, but it is key for the contract to close above 130.88.
Notionnel gapped up sharply at the open, bounding over resistance from the 130.88 contract high.
"The closes are very important," said Anil Patel technical analyst at Nomura International in London. "A close above 130.88, 131.00 will set up higher upper ranges."
September notionnel futures were up 0.40 at 131.10 by 0755 GMT, after earlier reaching a high of 131.24.

Independent technical analyst David Wood said the 130.88 level was backed up by the 130.84 high set on Tuesday, and should hold declines. On daily charts, a gap stretches down from the low so far on Wednesday at 131.06 to Tuesday's high.
Patel said there were some concerns that notionnel futures had been merely marked up in reaction to the jump in U.S. Treasuries, rather than from actual buying interest.
"But that could mean that if the flow is still bullish, people will be buying at higher levels and further the rally," he said. "The all-time highs are certainly under threat."
On continuation charts the all-time high was 132.94.
Further to the downside there was support at the July 17 high of 130.60, and then at 130.22, trendline support from joining the 129.80, 130.08 lows from July 15 and 21 respectively, Patel said.
At the short end, September PIBOR futures were up 0.01 at 96.57.
